verdict.rationale: Several skills explicitly produce AI-generated insights/suggestions from project data — e.g. a refactoring-target report ([mattpocock-skills-docs-18]), bug diagnosis from a repro ([mattpocock-skills-docs-19]), diff review against standards/spec ([mattpocock-skills-docs-14]), and cited answers from primary sources ([mattpocock-skills-docs-17]) — showing the skill set can surface data-driven suggestions inside an agent session. However this is not a dedicated analytics/insights feature; it's a byproduct of prompt/skill files, with community commentary questioning whether the prose adds real analytical value ([mattpocock-skills-comm-4], [mattpocock-skills-comm-6]). Missing for 10: a first-party demonstration of structured 'insight' output (dashboards, metrics, or scored recommendations) and independent hands-on verification that these skills reliably generate accurate insights rather than just prompting instructions.
